title: H20 Academy

services.name: Class Descriptions
services.desc: The H2O Academy believes everyone deserves an incredible swimming experience in a fun and safe environment. Through our proprietary AQUA-Lit™ Curriculum©, our purposefully designed lessons make learning fun, build confidence, and develop technical proficiency for students ages 4 months to adults. All classes are grouped by age and ability, with new clients beginning in a Splash class for their age group. Only swimmers who meet the required Shark benchmarks (confirmed by an H2O teacher during a Splash class) are eligible to advance to a Shark class. H2O reserves the right to remove students who do not meet benchmarks or whose behaviour affects class safety or management. FIRST SPLASH -

services.name: Aqua Zumba
services.desc: Jump into the ultimate pool party workout with Aqua Zumba®! This water-based fitness class blends Zumba's signature Latin-inspired rhythms and dance moves with the natural resistance of water for a high-energy, low-impact experience. We transform the pool into a vibrant dance floor, dimming the lights and adding disco ball effects to create a fun, welcoming environment where everyone can feel comfortable letting loose. No swimming skills are required-you’ll stay grounded while enjoying the water’s buoyancy. Tone and Condition: Aqua Zumba® helps tone muscles and improve cardio fitness while being gentle on your joints. Joint-Friendly: Perfect for anyone with joint concerns, such as arthritis
